note: 身份：绯红城的奖杯钓手，参与法师阵营任务，请玩家将 Volcanic Stonefish 送给 Odger，再带回装裱成品。常驻：Scarleton（绯红城）/ -112.5, 99, -844.5，沿用既有位置资料。关系：初见便自夸，随后托玩家跑腿；把 Odger 的挖苦当作熟人间的玩笑。说话风格：热情口语，爱聊钓鱼收藏和换鱼竿的打算。性格：自信又爱面子，看到玩家更大的渔获时失落、赌气。固定词汇/禁用：沿用熔岩钓鱼、奖杯鱼、奖杯钓鱼；NPC 人名保留英文；不写官腔、伪古风，不硬塞网络梗。

messages.context: Odexar：First Interaction
messages.text: Lava fishing is the best, it is my favorite pastime.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 熔岩钓鱼最棒了,这是我最喜欢的消遣。
messages.raw: §fLava fishing is the best, it is my favorite pastime.

messages.context: Odexar：First Interaction
messages.text: Do you like my collection of Trophies?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。Trophies 沿用项目 Trophy → 奖杯。
messages.zh: 喜欢我收藏的这些奖杯吗?
messages.raw: §fDo you like my collection of Trophies?

messages.context: Odexar：First Interaction
messages.text: Some fishes can only be caught under specific conditions, and it requires great focus.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 有些鱼只有在特定条件下才能钓到,而且必须全神贯注。
messages.raw: §fSome fishes can only be caught under specific conditions, and it requires great focus.

messages.context: Odexar：Quest Active (First Interaction)
messages.text: My name is Odexar! I have quite the reputation around here.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我叫 Odexar! 在这附近也算小有名气。
messages.raw: §fMy name is Odexar! I have quite the reputation around here.

messages.context: Odexar：Quest Active (First Interaction)
messages.text: You see, I'm the best lava fisher in the world.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你看,我可是全世界最厉害的熔岩钓手。
messages.raw: §fYou see, I'm the best lava fisher in the world.

messages.context: Odexar：Quest Active (First Interaction)
messages.text: Recently I fished a magnificent Volcanic Stonefish from a secret spot I won't reveal.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。用户拍板：所需物品 Volcanic Stonefish 无本地 GUI_Item 整名译文或适用物品名模板，保留完整原文；不能以其他 NPC 旧对白中的火山石鱼代替物品整名依据。
messages.zh: 最近,我在一个不能透露的秘密钓点钓到了一条绝佳的 Volcanic Stonefish。
messages.raw: §fRecently I fished a magnificent Volcanic Stonefish from a secret spot I won't reveal.

messages.context: Odexar：Quest Active (First Interaction)
messages.text: I would like to show it to Odger but I hurt my feet badly.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我很想拿给 Odger 看,可我的脚伤得不轻。
messages.raw: §fI would like to show it to Odger but I hurt my feet badly.

messages.context: Odexar：Quest Active (First Interaction)
messages.text: Would you mind taking my Volcanic Stonefish to Odger's house on top of the Volcano?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。用户拍板：所需物品 Volcanic Stonefish 无本地 GUI_Item 整名译文或适用物品名模板，保留完整原文。这里是请玩家送鱼到火山顶，不在对白中补入后续重新钓鱼的机制。
messages.zh: 能麻烦你把我的 Volcanic Stonefish 带到火山顶上 Odger 的家吗?
messages.raw: §fWould you mind taking my Volcanic Stonefish to Odger's house on top of the Volcano?

messages.context: Odexar：After claiming the  Volcanic Stonefish
messages.text: Thanks, I'm sure Odger will be proud, that is the best Trophy Fish I got in a long time!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。Trophy Fish 沿用 _shared/Terms.json 的用户确认译名奖杯鱼。
messages.zh: 谢啦,Odger 一定会为我骄傲的! 这可是我很久以来钓到的最好一条奖杯鱼!
messages.raw: §fThanks, I'm sure Odger will be proud, that is the best Trophy Fish I got in a long time!

messages.context: Odexar：Before giving the  Framed Volcanic Stonefish
messages.text: Odger lives in a house inside the Volcano at the very top, you can't miss it.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。用户拍板：任务交回物品 Framed Volcanic Stonefish 无本地 GUI_Item 整名译文或适用物品名模板，保留完整英文；这里只出现在条件说明中，不把物品名补入真实台词。
messages.zh: Odger 住在火山内部最高处的一间屋子里,你肯定不会错过。
messages.raw: §fOdger lives in a house inside the Volcano at the very top, you can't miss it.

messages.context: Odexar：Before giving the Framed Volcanic Stonefish
messages.text: Trophy Fishing is my passion, and Odger is the local specialist.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。Trophy Fishing 沿用奖杯钓鱼，不改为其他玩法或物品名。
messages.zh: 奖杯钓鱼是我的挚爱,Odger 则是本地这方面的专家。
messages.raw: §fTrophy Fishing is my passion, and Odger is the local specialist.

messages.context: Odexar：After giving the  Framed Volcanic Stonefish
messages.text: Marvelous! The Fish looks even better than I remembered!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 太棒了! 这条鱼看起来比我记忆中还漂亮!
messages.raw: §fMarvelous! The Fish looks even better than I remembered!

messages.context: Odexar：After giving the  Framed Volcanic Stonefish
messages.text: Odger has delicate hands, this is really top quality work!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: Odger 的手艺真细致,这绝对是顶级作品!
messages.raw: §fOdger has delicate hands, this is really top quality work!

messages.context: Odexar：After giving the  Framed Volcanic Stonefish
messages.text: What do you say? Odger said I was a bad fisherman?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你说什么?Odger 说我是个差劲的钓手?
messages.raw: §fWhat do you say? Odger said I was a bad fisherman?

messages.context: Odexar：After giving the  Framed Volcanic Stonefish
messages.text: Hahaha!! What a jokester this Odger, love that goblin.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哈哈哈!! Odger 可真会开玩笑,我就喜欢那只哥布林。
messages.raw: §fHahaha!! What a jokester this Odger, love that goblin.

messages.context: Odexar：After giving the  Framed Volcanic Stonefish
messages.text: Thanks a lot friend, here take those 80 coins. Don't spend them all in one go!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。80 coins 是这项任务的固定奖励，保留 80，不模板化成任意奖励数量。
messages.zh: 太谢谢你了,朋友。这 80 枚硬币拿去吧,可别一下全花光!
messages.raw: §fThanks a lot friend, here take those 80 coins. Don't spend them all in one go!

messages.context: Odexar：None
messages.text: My fishing rod is quite amazing but I'm still saving up for a better one, I can't wait!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我的鱼竿已经很厉害了,但我还在攒钱换一根更好的,真等不及了!
messages.raw: §fMy fishing rod is quite amazing but I'm still saving up for a better one, I can't wait!

messages.context: Odexar：None，闲聊自己的收藏
messages.text: The largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to 100 lb!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。这里的接近一米、接近 100 lb 是 NPC 固定自夸台词，不是玩家鱼的动态重量；保留既有字面值及感叹号，与物品触发版本的句号分别覆盖。
messages.zh: 我收藏里最大的鱼接近一米长,体重也快到 100 磅了!
messages.raw: §fThe largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to 100 lb!

messages.context: Odexar：After being shown a  Loudmouth Bass with mass of 101 lbs or more
messages.text: The largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to 100 lb.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。100 lb 是 NPC 固定收藏重量，101 lbs 是 Wiki 条件中的固定触发门槛，两者均不改为玩家鱼的动态重量。保留与闲聊版本不同的句号。
messages.zh: 我收藏里最大的鱼接近一米长,体重也快到 100 磅了。
messages.raw: §fThe largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to 100 lb.

messages.text: Wait, that Loudmouth Bass of yours is %s lbs...

messages.context: Odexar：After being shown a  Loudmouth Bass with mass of 101 lbs or more
messages.text: HOW???
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 怎么可能???
messages.raw: §fHOW???

messages.context: Odexar：After being shown a  Loudmouth Bass with mass of 101 lbs or more
messages.text: I really thought I was finally good at something for a while, you know?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你知道吗?有那么一阵子,我真以为自己终于有件事做得不错了。
messages.raw: §fI really thought I was finally good at something for a while, you know?

messages.context: Odexar：After being shown a  Loudmouth Bass with mass of 101 lbs or more
messages.text: And then you came on over here and trampled on my dreams.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 然后你跑过来,一脚把我的梦想踩碎了。
messages.raw: §fAnd then you came on over here and trampled on my dreams.

messages.context: Odexar：After being shown a  Loudmouth Bass with mass of 101 lbs or more
messages.text: Hope you feel real good about yourself, loudmouth.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。末尾 loudmouth 是对玩家赌气的称呼，与 Loudmouth Bass 鱼名形成双关；不因此给物品创造译名。
messages.zh: 希望你现在很得意,大嘴巴。
messages.raw: §fHope you feel real good about yourself, loudmouth.
